label: Pagination
description: Full pagination control: page numbers with ellipsis overflow, prev/next buttons, an optional rows-per-page selector and an optional "Showing X–Y of Z" summary. Inputs: Total Items, Items Per Page, Current Page. Outputs: Current Page, Offset (plugs into Query Records' Skip), Items Per Page (plugs into Limit) and a Changed signal. Merges the former Pages And Rows prefab.
